en: Multi-view black-and-white postcard with five photographs of urban and landscaped scenes and a central vertical title. The largest central inscription on the picture side reads "BRASOV" in stylized letters. The images show grand classical and neoclassical buildings, a large formal park with paths and a central monument or fountain, panoramic views of a city set among hills or low mountains, and residential blocks. The reverse side contains handwritten text in blue ink in Romanian, postal cancellation marks, a stamp box, printed words indicating it is a postcard, and the publisher name "Editura Meridiane".
